Package com.helix.core.cache

Class TieredRuleCache

java.lang.Object
com.helix.core.cache.TieredRuleCache
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public class TieredRuleCache extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Multi-tier rule cache supporting L1 (Strong Caffeine), L2 (SoftReference), L3 (WeakReference), and L4 (Distributed Redis) with promotion and cluster invalidation.
